sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "company_settings" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "company_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'КФХ', "director_name" TEXT NULL, "inn" TEXT NULL, "ogrn" TEXT NULL, "bank_account" TEXT NULL, "bank_name" TEXT NULL, "legal_address" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "default_work_day_hours" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 8.0, "overtime_multiplier" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.5, "night_shift_multiplier" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.2, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "employees" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" TEXT NOT NULL, "hire_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "dismissal_date" TEXT NULL, "base_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "field_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "employee_rates" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "base_rate" REAL NOT NULL, "field_rate" REAL NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timesheet" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'work', "days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "work_place" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "payment_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "payment_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'salary', "period_start" TEXT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "document_number" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sick_leave" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_number" TEXT NULL, "days_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_by_employer" REAL NULL, "paid_by_fss" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vacation" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "vacation_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'annual', "days_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_approved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_approved" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_results" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_id" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "edited_by" TEXT NULL, "remote_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (uuid) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "field_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sick_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vacation_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total_salary" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "base_rate_used" REAL NULL, "field_rate_used" REAL NULL, "calculated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'calculated', "skipped_work_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("uuid"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_changes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_employees_full_name ON employees (full_name)
CREATE INDEX idx_employee_rates_employee ON employee_rates (employee_uuid, start_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_timesheet_unique ON timesheet (employee_uuid, date) WHERE deleted = 0
CREATE INDEX idx_timesheet_date ON timesheet (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_payments_employee_date ON payments (employee_uuid, payment_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_payments_date ON payments (payment_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_sick_leave_employee ON sick_leave (employee_uuid)
CREATE INDEX idx_vacation_employee ON vacation (employee_uuid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_payroll_unique ON payroll_results (employee_uuid, year, month) WHERE deleted = 0
CREATE INDEX idx_payroll_period ON payroll_results (year, month)
